articles.text: Juan: Lo siento mucho. ¿La llevaste a la casa en seguida?
Juan: I'm very sorry. Did you take her home right away?
José: Sí, la llevé en un taxi.
José: Yes, I took her in a taxi.
Juan: Why didn't you let me know?
José: Yo volví a la fiesta después y te busqué, pero no te encontré. Había tanta gente.
José: I returned to the party afterwards and looked for you, but I didn't find you. There were so many people.
Juan: You're right. There were a great many.
